name: Favored Terrain Expert
body:
You are especially at home in a specific favored terrain.

Prerequisite(s): Favored terrain class feature.

Benefit(s): You may specify one of your favored terrains.

While in that terrain, you gain an additional +2 bonus to Knowledge (geography), Perception, Stealth, and Survival skill checks, and initiative.
